findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_dentist" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_dentist" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
